text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, right after training finished...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whew~, got in another good sweat today☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh, Palmer-chin, good work~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Helios!
Done for the day already?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"All done for the day~☆
Palmer-chin, you wrap-popping too? Let's go wiz!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, Helios!
I'm planning to stick around a bit longer today!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, fr?
Weren't they tryharding pretty bad?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Nah, I just felt like I can't afford to lose either.
Not when I've got a bestie trying way harder than me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Palmer-san's gonna get super powered up,
so look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ngggh!! Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna give it your all, Palmer-chin, then I'm going all out too!
We're BFFs for life, after all!
choice_data_list: If we're best friends forever, let's just watch over her.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Palmer-chiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, Helios!?
I thought you were going to turn in?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin isn't the only one
feeling super sparked up by her bestie!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna get serious too!!
Running together... and winning together!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mm, I see. That's true!
—Then let's go, Helios! Together!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy!
Let's get fired up together, Palmer-chin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And until the sun set,
I watched over them as they ran tirelessly
across the twilight course.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, "if it's a bestie"?
choice_data_list: We should respect our friend's wishes.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Palmer-chin's...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Palmer-san's gonna get a super power-up, so look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!!
Leader of the Pama-chin Lookout Squad, me☆, has arrived!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: First off, for my beloved bestie, I gotta get ready to blow all that fatigue away! And then, and then!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A powered-up Palmie!?
I am mega excited to see it~~~!
